sentences.text:
Jayanta Biswas @ Baban & Anr vs Unknown on 12 September,
2024
 12.09.2024
 Ct. No. 06
 Sl No. 106
 S.De
 C.R.M. (Db) 2981 of 2024

In Re: - An application for bail under Section 439 of the 
 Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 483 of the Bha
 Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023 in connection with Chakdah P
 No. 584 of 2024 dated June 2, 2024 under Sections
 341/323/376/417/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

And
 In the matter of: Jayanta Biswas @ Baban & Anr.
 Mr. Shibaji Kumar Das, ...for the Petiti
 Mr. Debabrata Chatterjee,
 Mr. Sandip Kundu, ....for the State.
 Mr. Anit Dey, ...for the de facto complainan
 1.
Heard the learned lawyers for both the parties.
2. We have considered the materials on record.
Petitioner no.1 cohabited with an adult lady.
They are in custody for 60 and 50 days respectively.
Whether the cohabitation was procured through deception requires to be assessed during trial.
3. In view of the aforesaid facts we are of the opinion further detention of the petitioners is not necessary and they may be enlarged on bail.

4. Accordingly, we direct the petitioners viz. Jayanta Biswas @ Baban and Lakhsman @ Laxman @
Lakshman Biswas shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-each with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kalyani, Nadia subject to the condition that the petitioners shall appear before the trial court on each and every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses and/or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever.

Signed By :
